title: Exchange and replay chat through the certified loopback listener
spec: Generate a synthetic authority and two device certificates in a test. Use the real admission verifier, loopback listener, absolute stream deadlines, and sign-in and chat sessions to refuse a certless peer with zero application bytes and refuse an enrolled device that claims a different account. Both correctly signed-in clients post and receive messages with preserved authors and cursors. Close the listener, reopen the same message journal, and assert a freshly signed-in client can sync both messages. Keep all account and certificate fixture logic in the test. Fixture state may stay in memory across the journal restart.
